visualCharacteristics.purpose: Horizontal icon + linked-title tiles that act as in-page navigation to sections further down
visualCharacteristics.description: Repeating structure of six identical icon + linked-title tiles.

contentPattern.structure: Repeating rows, one per tile: cell 1 = icon image (white glyph, coloured square is styling); cell 2 = heading (H3) containing a link. Use same-page anchors such as #connect-strategy; the whole tile is clickable

cells: H3 containing link 'A metadata foundation for planning and execution' to #connect-strategy
H3 containing link 'AI-powered creative foundation' to #enhance-creative
H3 containing link 'Asset variations at scale' to #create-quality
H3 containing link 'Content creation for all teams' to #unlock-brand
H3 containing link 'Content discovery and reuse' to #quickly-find-content

blockContent.notes: Icons are white glyphs; the coloured square behind each icon (purple to pink across the set) is block styling. Source hrefs are /solutions/content-supply-chain.html#<anchor>; author them as same-page anchors.

usage: Use as a jump-link grid to sections on the same page. Author each link as a bare #anchor that matches a section id (section metadata "anchor" or a heading id). Links to the current page path plus #hash are rewritten to bare #hash at runtime.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any icon + single linked title tile list, in-page or cross-page. Off-page links are left as authored.
